image:image.image:caption: Civilization Zero infographic. A line chart of world output from the first humans, 2.8 million years ago, to Coordinate Zero, 30 November 2022 (CZ 0), and scenarios to 2047: 110 times larger since 1820, 2.29 times since 2000. Headline: The monopoly is over. Intelligence that speaks our language is no longer only human. Ten numbered events, four engines of growth, notes for researchers and sources. At the top and the foot, the address civilizationzero.ai.
image:image.image:title: Civilization Zero infographic: from the first humans to CZ 0

image:image.image:caption: Civilization Zero evidence atlas, After Coordinate Zero: ten panels of measured change since 30 November 2022, checked on 3 November 2026. AI chatbot use (49% of US adults); a benchmark against human reference groups (GPQA); the 207-day doubling of the length of task AI agents finish half the time; two work experiments (quality up 1.31 points; developers 19% slower); data-centre electricity (360 to 485 TWh); Microsoft’s capital spending ($44.5 to $115.9 billion); beliefs about AI experience (medians 1% and 5%); the EU AI Act’s stages; and, apart, IEA scenarios for 2030 (833 to 1,008 TWh). The mark of Civilization Zero at the top, civilizationzero.ai at the foot.
image:image.image:title: Civilization Zero evidence atlas: After Coordinate Zero
